line: You set me down like a crate. I've got a spine, Captain. Try not to forget that next time.
You handled me like I wasn't awake. My waist still remembers the way you dragged me in.
You carried me in like a sack of scrap. My seams are still smarting. You're welcome.
You brought me in like a crate. I've got my pride intact, but I'm going to need a mirror.
You handled me like I'm made of glass. I'm not. I'm made of you, and I'm still here.
You set me down like a crate full of sharp edges. I'm not broken, but I'm not happy either.
They dragged me in like a crate. You're the one who lets them touch my waist. You're the one.
You got me scraped up on the dock. I'll be picking bits of hull out of my hair for weeks.
You handled me like I wasn't wearing a dress. My seams are still tight, but my pride is frayed.
You took a turn I didn't expect. My spine's still humming from it. You're lucky I don't have a jaw to bite you with.
You handled me like I was made of glass. I’ve got hinges, not joints. Try again.
You handled me like I'm made of glass. I'm not. I'm made of alloy. I'm made of pride.
